steps.title: Prepare normalized libraries
steps.instruction: Retrieve the normalized libraries from the Bio‑Rad 96‑well plate (200 µL wells) generated in Part 3 and keep the plate on the deck.

steps.title: Pool equal volumes
steps.instruction: Transfer equal volumes from each well into a single 2 mL tube placed in the Opentrons tube rack (slot 2), mixing gently to create the pooled library.

steps.title: Dilute pooled library
steps.instruction: Dilute the pooled library with the appropriate buffer to the final concentration required for sequencing (exact volume not specified in the protocol).

steps.title: Heat‑denature library
steps.instruction: Heat‑denature the diluted library at the temperature recommended by Illumina before loading onto the sequencer.

steps.title: Store unused library
steps.instruction: Aliquot any unused pooled library into the PAL tube and SGP plate and store at –25 °C to –15 °C for up to 7 days.

steps.title: Configure robot settings
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app (OT‑2 Run App version 3.15.0 or later), select all desired settings according to the “Setup” section, then download the customized OT‑2 protocol using the blue “Download” button above the deck map.

steps.title: Upload protocol to app
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons app, follow the on‑screen instructions to set up the deck, calibrate labware, and start the run.

steps.title: Arrange deck labware
steps.instruction: Place the 96‑well plate containing the samples in slot 1 and the 2 mL tube rack in slot 2; load tubes sequentially starting at A1, then B1, etc.
